# activedirectory_groups (Data Source)

Search for groups under a container by scope and filter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Search for groups under a container. A raw ldap_filter is passed through
# verbatim, so you own its correctness; filter_by is the escaped, friendlier
# path for simple equality.
data "activedirectory_groups" "app_groups" {
  container   = "OU=Groups,DC=corp,DC=local"
  scope       = "subtree"
  ldap_filter = "(name=app-*)"
}

output "app_group_dns" {
  value = [for g in data.activedirectory_groups.app_groups.groups : g.dn]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `container` (String) SearchBase DN. Defaults to the domain root.
- `filter_by` (Map of String) Attribute equality terms, ANDed. Values are escaped for you.
- `ldap_filter` (String) Raw LDAP filter, ANDed with filter_by. You own its correctness.
- `max_results` (Number) Cap on results (default 1000). Exceeding it is an error, not truncation.
- `scope` (String) base, one_level, or subtree (default).

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) Matching groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) security or distribution.
- `container` (String) Distinguished name of the parent.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `dn` (String) The distinguished name.
- `guid` (String) The objectGUID.
- `id` (String) The objectGUID.
- `managed_by` (String) DN of the managing principal.
- `name` (String) The group's name (RDN).
- `sam_account_name` (String) The sAMAccountName.
- `scope` (String) global, domainlocal, or universal.
- `sid` (String) The security identifier.
